symptom: After MDL055 learned the two-hop form, three combo box shapes from mendixlabs/mxcli#1466 still passed `mxcli check` and `exec` and failed mxbuild: a one-hop comparand landing on another entity than the left side (`[Mod.District_Region = $currentObject/Mod.AreaPicker_City]`) and an unqualified comparand association (`$currentObject/AreaPicker_Region`), both CE0161 "Error(s) in XPath constraint.", and an association-mode combo box with no caption (the issue's actual script), CE0642 "Property 'Caption' is required."
cause: No rule judged the TYPE of a one-hop variable comparand — MDL055 counts hops only, and MDL-XPATH01 ran over microflow retrieves only; MDL-WIDGET16 returned clean as soon as an association-mode combo box had a data source, never asking for the caption that mode requires
file: `mdl/executor/validate_datasource_xpath_comparand.go` (`ValidateDatasourceXPathComparands`, MDL-XPATH02 + the page arm of MDL-XPATH01, wired in `ValidateProgram`), `mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go` (`validateComboBoxCaption` under MDL-WIDGET16), `memberTypeIndex` now buildable from the script alone (`overlayScriptMembers`)
insight: **Give every page of a multi-page measurement project its own widget NAME.** mxbuild's message carries only the widget name (`at Combo box 'cb'`), so sixteen pages with a `cb` each gave eleven unattributable errors; naming each widget after its page made one `mx check` answer the whole matrix. Measured identically on fresh 11.13.0 and 11.14.0: a comparand landing on a specialization OR a generalization of the left side's entity builds clean (so the type rule compares generalization chains, and stays silent when a chain runs through an entity it does not hold), association-vs-attribute is CE0161 too, and the caption is whichever one the caption TYPE selects — `optionsSourceAssociationCaptionType: expression` with only `CaptionAttribute:` is CE0642, and so is an expression without the type; enumeration mode needs no caption. A data source alone selects association mode, so the `Attribute:` spelling of the association needs the caption as well — reading `Association:` first would have missed it. The type rule runs in the no-project tier from the script's declarations (the issue is one script declaring everything), with -p filling in the rest; putting it in the --references walk would have left `mxcli check script.mdl` silent on the reported shape. No language-version gate: each refused form already fails the build.
